source.attribution: Educational model generated procedurally by 3D Education Engine, based on textbook descriptions of cardiac muscle histology.

educational.disclaimer: Educational model — not to scale. Striations drawn every 6 µm; real sarcomeres repeat every ~2 µm.

cardiomyocytes.name: Cardiac muscle cells
cardiomyocytes.description: Branched, striated muscle cells that contract rhythmically without conscious control.

nuclei.name: Nuclei
nuclei.description: Usually one (sometimes two) central nucleus per cell, unlike skeletal muscle fibres, which have many nuclei at their edge.

intercalated_discs.name: Intercalated discs
intercalated_discs.description: Junctions joining the cells end to end. Desmosomes hold the cells together and gap junctions let the electrical signal pass, so the cells contract together.

capillaries.name: Capillaries
capillaries.description: A dense capillary network brings oxygen: heart muscle relies almost entirely on aerobic respiration.
